newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyonnaise Cable sets digital TV launch.
newsitem.headline: Lyonnaise Cable sets digital TV launch.

text.p: Lyonnaise Cable, the cable television unit of Lyonnaise des Eaux, said on Thursday it would launch a digital television service on all its cable television networks in France from June 2.

It said in a statement its decoder, using simulcrypt software, will be able to receive the channels currently available on rival digital satellite services Canalsatellite, part of Canal Plus, and TPS (Television par Satellite), operated by TF1.
The move will allow it to offer three times as many film channels with various subscription possibilities, it said.
It plans to increase its offering in September and by the end of the year will offer 70 channels and services.
It will run a national advertising campaign on the launch from next Monday until June 2.
